title: When the Recipe Falls
author: Marguerite Kavanagh
blurb: Freya Iversen, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
